# Iron Ledger

> Every set. Every rep. Accounted for.

Iron Ledger is a clean, modular Python SDK and CLI for importing, validating, and managing workout routines in the Hevy app via the official Hevy API v1.

## Key Files
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full LLM guidelines, architecture map, and Gitmoji / Conventional Commits rules.
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview and user documentation.
- [cli.py](cli.py): CLI entrypoint for routine uploading (`upload`, `--dry-run`, `--folder`).
- [iron_ledger/config.py](iron_ledger/config.py): Environment configuration loader.
- [iron_ledger/api/client.py](iron_ledger/api/client.py): Hevy API HTTP client with auto-pagination and 429 retry backoff.
- [iron_ledger/domain/mapper.py](iron_ledger/domain/mapper.py): 3-pass fuzzy exercise matcher against Hevy template library.
- [iron_ledger/importer/importer.py](iron_ledger/importer/importer.py): Core import orchestrator (validate → folder → map → routine).
- [iron_ledger/importer/validator.py](iron_ledger/importer/validator.py): Program definition validator.
- [iron_ledger/workouts/periodizacao_ab_ab_fullbody.py](iron_ledger/workouts/periodizacao_ab_ab_fullbody.py): 5-day AB-AB-FullBody workout program definition.
- [tests/](tests/): Pytest suite for validator and fuzzy mapper.

## Usage
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python cli.py upload --dry-run
python cli.py upload iron_ledger/workouts/periodizacao_ab_ab_fullbody.py --folder "Periodização AB-AB-FullBody (5 Dias)"
python -m pytest tests/ -v
```
